checkedAlternates.risk: WTO works closely on global trade finance like the IMF.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The WTO is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland (group-4), whereas the Bretton Woods institutions (IMF & World Bank) sit in Washington, D.C. (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: IAEA is a major UN-system agency.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The IAEA is headquartered at the Vienna International Centre in Austria (group-1), not Geneva (group-4).
